claim: The perfect-matching complex of the dodecahedral graph \(D=\operatorname{GP}(10,2)\) has homotopy type \(\mathcal P(D)\simeq M(\mathbb Z/2,2)\vee\bigvee^{20}S^3\), with \(\widetilde H_2\cong\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z\) and \(\widetilde H_3\cong\mathbb Z^{20}\).
integrity_notes: The standalone standard-library checker recreates all faces, verifies acyclicity, produces the integral critical-cell differential, checks a determinant-two maximal minor and mod-two rank nine, and independently checks original-complex mod-two homology. A complete critical-cell boundary certificate is included.
scientific_limitations: A single finite graph, not a general theorem for regular cubic graphs. Homotopy follows from exact finite acyclic discrete-Morse reduction and integer attaching-degree calculation; no independent audit or peer review. Equivalent unindexed prior work remains possible.
title: A Moore-space summand in the dodecahedral perfect-matching complex
